rep.name: First turn
rep.challenge: Turn the orange ring until its gap reaches the hook. A ring with nothing left to hold shatters.

rep.name: Held
rep.challenge: Only the last ring turns: the others are held by their own arms. Start at the end of the chain.

rep.name: Flower
rep.challenge: Four petals hook the center. One long turn of the center frees them all at once.

rep.name: Swing
rep.challenge: Free the small ring, then the middle ring carries its arm. One way the arm hits the hook above; turn the other way.

rep.name: Bridge
rep.challenge: The middle ring is closed and cannot let go of anything. Free both sides; it shatters when nothing holds it.

rep.name: Make way
rep.challenge: The right ring cannot finish: its arm runs into the arm of the left ring. Turn the left ring first to clear the path.

rep.name: Rail
rep.challenge: The bar rests on both rings. Turn each ring until its gap passes the end of the bar.

rep.name: Detour
rep.challenge: Each pillar ring carries a free arm once its outer ring is gone. The arm cannot pass under the bar: the two pillars turn opposite ways.

rep.name: Gate
rep.challenge: The gate stands on two posts that also hold the middle ring. A long turn of a post runs its free arm into the gate: free the hook with a short turn one way, then the gate end with a short turn the other way.

rep.name: Frame
rep.challenge: A pinned frame on four corners with a pinwheel inside. Each corner holds two bar ends and a hook: find the turn that frees all three. A pinwheel ring can only let go once the corner it hooks is gone.

rep.name: Ladder
rep.challenge: Breather: a hanging chain with a pinned rung on each ring. Work up from the bottom; each ring must drop its rung before its free arm swings into it.

rep.name: Knot
rep.challenge: The blue ring hooks the bar and can never let go. Turn the orange ring the short way so its bomb hits the bar. The long way frees the pin first and the bomb is lost.

rep.name: Aim
rep.challenge: Two rings sit beside the bomb ring. The right one can be freed by turning it; the closed one on the left cannot. Send the bomb left.

rep.name: Long way
rep.challenge: Free the small ring, then turn the bomb ring. The short way runs the bomb into its own pin; go the long way round to the knot.

rep.name: Scales
rep.challenge: The beam rests on two closed, pinned pans: two knots. Each bomb can hit its pan or the beam. Hitting the beam wastes a bomb and the pans stay stuck. Free the bottom first, then aim each bomb out at its pan before its gap lets go of the hook.

rep.name: Ring road
rep.challenge: Breather: around the road, two rings hold each other and neither can turn. Clear the road up to the bomb ring and send its bomb into the pair.

rep.name: Key
rep.challenge: The blue ring is locked: a tap only shakes it. Free the yellow ring that carries its key, then the blue ring turns.

rep.name: Key bar
rep.challenge: The key hangs on the bar. Free both bar ends, the bar comes out and the locked ring opens.

rep.name: Key chain
rep.challenge: Three rings in a triangle: the top one holds the key of the left, the left one the key of the right. Open them in order.

rep.name: Vault
rep.challenge: The bomb ring is locked; its key sits on the gate bar. Take the gate down first, then aim the bomb at the closed ring and not at the free one beside it.
